pairs.label: Luke 6:12–16
pairs.before: Family tradition, recorded in Church History Topics, tells that Emma’s father overheard young Emma praying in the woods and was moved by what he heard. Luke 6:12–16 shows Jesus spending a night in prayer before choosing the Twelve. Read the passage beside Emma’s story, and let it leave room for you to bring your own decisions before God.

pairs.label: John 4:31–34
pairs.before: At Jacob’s well, the disciples urged Jesus to eat. He spoke to them about doing His Father’s will. Read John 4:31–34 beside this part of Emma’s story: the care Emma gave in these years was work with a deep purpose, and she gave it as someone who also needed food, rest, and care.
